scene.calibration: target-absent episodes of the training split
scene.position_grid: frozen with the episode set before training
scene.run_structure: comparable in kind with the cuSense campaign: open indoor space, one walking person, equal numbers of target-present and target-absent runs

runtime.meaning: The graded cuSense-like branch runs in the native core: CUDA kernels and a TensorRT engine in sense_host, with no Python in the process. Its latency is shown, and recorded beside the published figure without being graded.
runtime.comparison_arm: the same pipeline on the reference runtime, PyTorch in a Python sensor, on the same records
runtime.delay_doppler_branch: reference runtime on the CPU until S6.12, so that the timed arms hold two CUDA clients
runtime.requires: the TensorRT probe of S3.6 on the Spark (checkpoint D0); a LibTorch showing is labeled and does not stand in for it

sensing.input: the receiver's own estimate (O3, S5.2) for the cuSense-like branch; observer pilot LS (O2) for the delay-Doppler branch, as parity reference and as fallback

cusense_like.model: plain-block 1D CNN with a location grid and a jointly trained presence logit
cusense_like.input_support: 4 RX x 612 subcarriers x 2 DMRS symbols, after frequency interpolation and smoothing, before time interpolation
cusense_like.window: UL slots of one TDD period, coherent average
cusense_like.normalization: z-score fitted on the training split only
cusense_like.fallback_input: o2_pilot_ls on the comb, 306 pilot subcarriers per DMRS symbol

process_layout.receiver_and_sensor: two processes, two clients of one MPS server
process_layout.in_process_placement: control cell of S5.5 on the staged harness, after the demonstration; not part of this profile

queue.rings: one per observation stream: O3 to sense_host, O2 to the reference sensor
queue.slots_rule: records held in place by the plan, plus one uplink burst, plus one, rounded up to a power of two
queue.full_ring: the new observation is dropped and counted; the radio job continues

sensor.behind_by_more_than_one_window: skip to the newest complete window and count the records passed

contention_controls.applied_when: the concurrent arm moves the radio tail beyond the rule declared in S4.6

kpi_page.viewer: second machine through an SSH tunnel

service_levels.rules: declared and hashed before measuring; derived from training and validation episodes only; verified on a second run
service_levels.sensing_deadlines: acquisition time plus a margin on the measured post-window service of the concurrent arm
service_levels.valid_for: the recorded host state; S5.6 recalibrates on the tuned host

cusense_reference.published_live_inference_serving_option: native: CUDA preprocessing and a TensorRT engine in the dApp, GH200 with MIG
differences_to_list: simulated scene against an over-the-air room
cusense_reference.aim: comparable performance in software, judged as S1.2 judged the DeepSig Table II timing

illustrative_demo_gates.absent_missing_rule: Report valid absent decisions. Mark inconclusive if unobserved alerts could change the false-alarm verdict.
illustrative_demo_gates.position_error_rule: Report mean, median and 90th percentile in metres with the eligible count. Recorded beside the cuSense reference and not graded.
illustrative_demo_gates.deadline_rule: Gates use the calibrated values of S4.6, never the starting proposals.

ue_realization.meaning: No UE, 5GC or PRACH procedure. A Sionna RT radar CFR applied to a legal grant at the receiver stands in for a connected UE.
